experiments.label: register-qualified nested scalar lifetimes
experiments.hypothesis: Explicit register-qualified base, component, limit, and angle scalars in separate lexical scopes may change MWCC interference priority and reproduce retail f2/f1/f0 allocation without changing the expression schedule.
experiments.source_shape: Each wrap block used register float base, component, limit, angle; assignments retained retail load order; the variant was rejected and is not the committed source.
experiments.command: build/tools/objdiff-cli diff -p . -u main/game/game_fn_801F02C4 -o reports/GEDE01/objdiff-1a89de79-730b-4a4b-b7d8-9004875c08f3-register-scopes.json --format json-pretty -c function_reloc_diffs=name_address fn_801F02C4
experiments.outcome: No instruction or relocation change from the accepted candidate.

experiments.label: scalar-replaced aggregate temporaries
experiments.hypothesis: Placing base, component, limit, and angle in a local WrapTemps aggregate may alter SSA creation and MWCC FPR coloring after scalar replacement while retaining the retail schedule.
experiments.source_shape: Each wrap block used a local four-float WrapTemps aggregate; the variant was rejected and is not the committed source.
experiments.command: build/tools/objdiff-cli diff -p . -u main/game/game_fn_801F02C4 -o reports/GEDE01/objdiff-1a89de79-730b-4a4b-b7d8-9004875c08f3-aggregate-temps.json --format json-pretty -c function_reloc_diffs=name_address fn_801F02C4
experiments.outcome: MWCC fully scalarized the aggregate but emitted the same instruction and relocation stream as the accepted candidate.
